// Generated by Jeeves. Change event contracts and preset in the design.
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { setTimeout as delay } from "node:timers/promises";
import { DeliveryWorker, Outbox, type DeliveryDatabase, type ProducerTransaction } from "@jeeves/durable-events";
import type { Dependency, ServicePlugin } from "@jeeves/service-runtime";
import { events, type Payloads } from "./contracts.ts";
%%HANDLER_IMPORTS%%

export interface Producer extends Omit<ProducerTransaction, "emit"> {
  emit<K extends keyof Payloads>(event: K, key: string, payload: Payloads[K]): ReturnType<ProducerTransaction["emit"]>;
}

/** Authorization and command idempotency belong to the caller. Tenant must come from trusted identity. */
export function createDeliveryBinding(database: () => DeliveryDatabase) {
  const store = new Outbox({ connect: () => database().connect() }, {
    queue: %%QUEUE%%, preset: %%PRESET%%, events: Object.values(events),
  });
  const worker = new DeliveryWorker(store, [%%HANDLERS%%]);
  const controller = new AbortController();
  let running = false;
  let failed = false;
  let work: Promise<void> | undefined;
  const dependency: Dependency = {
    name: "durable-events",
    async start(log) {
      const sql = readFileSync(new URL("../../event-migrations/0001.sql", import.meta.url), "utf8");
      const hash = createHash("sha256").update(sql).digest("hex");
      if (hash !== %%MIGRATION_HASH%%) throw new Error("Durable event migration checksum mismatch");
      const client = await database().connect();
      try {
        await client.query("BEGIN");
        await client.query("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'");
        await client.query("SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '30s'");
        await client.query("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7340215003)");
        await client.query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.jeeves_event_schema_v1 (id text PRIMARY KEY, sha256 text NOT NULL)");
        const applied = await client.query("SELECT id,sha256 FROM public.jeeves_event_schema_v1");
        if (applied.rows.some((row) => row.id !== "jeeves-durable-events-0001" || row.sha256 !== hash)) throw new Error("Applied durable event migration differs from the published schema");
        if (!applied.rows.length) {
          await client.query(sql);
          await client.query("INSERT INTO public.jeeves_event_schema_v1 (id,sha256) VALUES ($1,$2)", ["jeeves-durable-events-0001", hash]);
        }
        await client.query("COMMIT");
        log.info("Durable event schema ready");
      } catch (error) {
        await client.query("ROLLBACK").catch(() => {});
        throw error;
      } finally { client.release(); }
    },
    async ready() {
      return running && !failed && !controller.signal.aborted ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, error: failed ? "worker failed" : "worker stopped" };
    },
    async close() { controller.abort(); await work; },
  };
  const plugin: ServicePlugin = {
    name: "durable-events",
    register(app, ctx) {
      app.addHook("onReady", async () => {
        running = true;
        work = (async () => {
          while (!controller.signal.aborted) {
            try {
              await worker.run(controller.signal, () => { failed = false; });
              break;
            } catch (error) {
              const code = typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "code" in error ? String(error.code) : "";
              const transient = ["08000", "08001", "08003", "08004", "08006", "57P01", "57P02", "57P03", "53300", "40001", "40P01", "ECONNREFUSED", "ECONNRESET", "ETIMEDOUT", "EPIPE", "EAI_AGAIN", "ENOTFOUND", "ENETUNREACH", "EHOSTUNREACH", "ENETDOWN"].includes(code) || (error instanceof Error && ["Connection terminated unexpectedly", "Connection terminated", "Connection terminated due to connection timeout", "Client has encountered a connection error and is not queryable", "Client was closed and is not queryable", "timeout expired"].includes(error.message));
              const diagnostic = /^(?:[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{3}|E[A-Z_]{1,24})$/.test(code) ? code : "unclassified";
              if (!failed) ctx.log.warn(`Durable event worker unavailable (${diagnostic}); readiness is disabled`);
              failed = true;
              if (!transient) { ctx.log.error(`Durable event worker failed (${diagnostic}); restart required`); break; }
              try { await delay(1000, undefined, { signal: controller.signal }); }
              catch (error) { if (!controller.signal.aborted) throw error; }
            }
          }
        })().catch(() => { failed = true; }).finally(() => { running = false; });
      });
      app.addHook("onClose", async () => { controller.abort(); await work; });
    },
  };
  return {
    dependency, plugin,
    transaction<T>(tenantId: string, action: (tx: Producer) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
      return store.transaction(tenantId, (tx) => action({
        query: (sql, values) => tx.query(sql, values),
        emit: (event, key, payload) => tx.emit<unknown>(events[event], key, payload),
      }));
    },
    status: (tenantId: string, id: string) => store.status(tenantId, id),
    list: (tenantId: string, options?: Parameters<Outbox["list"]>[1]) => store.list(tenantId, options),
  };
}
